fields.value: Fast, approximately evenly spaced negative-trough sequence with a conditional window mean near 121 bpm. Each sharp positive-to-negative contour merges into broader upward recovery, leaving QRS termination unresolved. PR remains held and no sinus, junctional or other rhythm origin is established.
fields.basis: New independently reviewed educational synthesis of the exact original raster, conditional source measurements and stated course criteria; not a source-authored or educator-validated rhythm answer
fields.reason: No diagnostic rhythm label, validated P-wave identity, conduction interval or clinical conclusion is assigned. Qualified ECG educator review has not occurred. Optional educational comparison only, not a source-authored answer or confirmed rhythm diagnosis. A candidate atrial association is not proof of sinus or retrograde origin. Timing retains the recorded calibration assumptions and holds. Interval envelopes apply to the selected endpoint-review cycles and describe boundary uncertainty, not actual beat-to-beat variability, normal conduction or a full-strip atrial census. These newly derived observations remain unscored and are not eligible as validated answer keys.

limitations: Wave observations and conditional endpoint envelopes remain provisional and unscored. QT/QTc, calibrated amplitudes and clinical diagnosis are not established. Selected-complex widths do not establish sequence certainty.
